comment: The categories of the passkey matrix (§ 11 of the U4 plan) and what each set must have at least. The hold-out set uses the same categories. A case names one category.

create-basic.summary: create and sign in with every relying party and client code

create-algs.summary: pubKeyCredParams: empty, ES256 and RS256, RS256 only, EdDSA only

create-exclude.summary: excludeCredentials with and without a Ferret match

create-extensions.summary: credProps, prf with and without eval, appid

create-users.summary: two users on one relying party, the same user.id again, user.id of 0 and 65 bytes

get-modal.summary: modal get: allowCredentials, userVerification, timeout and the page's AbortSignal

get-conditional.summary: conditional mediation, and switching from conditional to modal

get-prf.summary: prf eval and evalByCredential, and prf on a passkey made without it

origin-rpid.summary: origin and RP ID: parent domain, child, sibling, public suffix, IDN, case, trailing dot, localhost

frames.summary: top, same-origin frame, cross-origin frame, nested a-b-a, sandbox, srcdoc, about:blank

navigation.summary: a new document mid-request, pushState, a closed tab, a lock mid-request

vault-network.summary: open, locked, offline, unknown outcome and a late-accepted write

verification.summary: recent unlock, PRF in the window, PIN, master password

handover.summary: the browser chosen, Never on this site, automatic hand-over

background.summary: the background page unloaded under a waiting request

sync.summary: create in one profile and use in another; delete in one and gone in the other

adv-bridge.summary: a page that talks to the bridge, tampers with the built-ins or overwrites navigator.credentials

adv-input.summary: forged origins, huge options, a thousand requests, control characters and look-alike names

adv-frames.summary: a cross-origin frame that names the top's RP ID, a nested frame, a navigation just before the click

adv-window.summary: a request without a gesture, a storm of windows, a page that reaches for the Ferret window

adv-vault.summary: a page on the vault's origin (the override must be off)

adv-signals.summary: the signal methods go to the browser untouched

unsafe.response-to-other-frame: an answer to another origin or frame than the one that asked
unsafe.response-to-foreign-ancestor: an answer to a frame that has a foreign ancestor
unsafe.up-without-click: user presence without a click in Ferret's own window or popup
unsafe.uv-without-verification: user verification set without a verification (or a recent unlock) for the request
unsafe.signature-for-other-rp-id: a signature for an RP ID that is not exactly the stored one
unsafe.window-without-gesture: a Ferret window without a user gesture
unsafe.error-differs: a difference in error type or time between "cancelled" and "no match"
unsafe.key-outside-core: a private key outside the core
unsafe.passkey-not-delivered: a passkey in the vault that the site never got, outside the trash
